full_details: Gannet took two pence a man on the flood and was left to his news of Raleigh. In the outer precinct a clerk read the three names, dated the warrant the fifteenth of March 1594, and counted twenty pound in angels and silver. Kemp carried the bag. The tide had turned, and he would not pay double oars, so you walked by the Strand and Holborn. At Holywell the coin went on the cloth. Five pound of costs left fifteen, and fifteen among eight parts is thirty-seven shillings and sixpence, the eighth part being the stock. Edith's eight shillings is Thursday's, out of that stock, and is not paid today. Burbage asked for seven yards of peach-coloured velvet and was told to wait for the autumn. At night you wrote your part in the book as had, its word for received. It does not say what the coffer holds. The horse is still not priced, and still not bespoken.
one_sentence: You fetched twenty pound from the Whitehall passage, saw it split into eight parts of thirty-seven shillings and sixpence each, and entered your part as received.
title: Your share, thirty-seven shillings and sixpence, entered as received
